hypothesis_results.title: Dust accumulation in swap-by-output operations
hypothesis_results.evidence: 100 swap-by-output operations produced 0 dust accumulation. Part2 test (H-R7-CP-06) confirmed: 100 swaps of 10 USDC each with 5% fee produced 0 dust0 and 0 dust1. Dust is correctly bounded by single-output-unit potential.

hypothesis_results.title: Fee path divergence between swapByInput and swapByOutput
hypothesis_results.evidence: Path A (input-based, 1000e6 USDC, 100 BPS fee) cost 1,000,000,000 for 188,100,000,000,000,000 WETH output. Path B (output-based, same output) cost identically 1,000,000,000. No exploitable divergence.

hypothesis_results.title: Precision truncation over-withdrawal in partial removeLiquidity
hypothesis_results.evidence: Requesting 1 wei withdrawal returns 7,500,000,000 (7.5 USDC) with spacing=10 (precision=10^10). This is by-design minimum granularity. The LP position is correctly reduced by the withdrawn amount. The LP cannot extract more than their total position value. Solvency check passes. Not exploitable — the redeposit amount is truncated to the nearest precision boundary, and the 'excess' is the difference between requested and truncated redeposit.

hypothesis_results.title: consumedLiquidity underflow with multiple overlapping LP positions
hypothesis_results.evidence: Two LPs with equal 5000e6 deposits, swap consumes ~60%, both withdraw successfully. LP_A: 7,850,000,000 USDC + 4,999,430,000,000,000,000,000 WETH. LP_B: identical. No underflow. Total withdrawn <= total deposited + fees. Solvency check passes.

hypothesis_results.title: position0ShareOf0 drift under repeated alternating swaps
hypothesis_results.evidence: 50 alternating swaps (25 forward + 25 reverse) of varying sizes. Final consumedLiquidity0=100,000,000,000. LP successfully withdrew all liquidity (0 USDC, 100,020,000,000,000,000,000,000 WETH). Solvency maintained. No share drift detected.

hypothesis_results.title: swapByOutput DoS via arithmetic underflow in _splitAmountsAndFeesByHeight
hypothesis_results.evidence: Tested with both-sides-consumed state across spacing 3, 5, and 10. All swap-by-output operations succeeded (amounts 1 to 5,000,000,000). No arithmetic underflow at line 1642. The code path at lines 1636-1648 handles returnableInput correctly even when both inputShareOfExpectedReserve and outputShareOfExpectedReserve are non-zero. Tested in both swap directions (0->1 and 1->0).

hypothesis_results.title: Tail height arithmetic revert in _increaseHeight
hypothesis_results.evidence: Pool with 10e6 USDC, consumed 90% via 9e6 USDC input swap. Subsequent 1e6 swap succeeded (1,000,000 in, 190,000,000,000,000 out). Even 100e6 oversized swap succeeded as partial fill (100,000,000 in, 19,000,000,000,000,000 out). expectedReserve correctly bounds output before reaching tail arithmetic. Solvency maintained.

hypothesis_results.title: Fee-on-swap dust accumulation with pool fees
hypothesis_results.evidence: 100 swaps of 10 USDC each with 500 BPS (5%) pool fee. Total dust0=0, total dust1=0. Average fee per swap=493,750. All excess input correctly converted to LP fees, not accumulated as unrecoverable dust.

invariant_results.title: No profitable round-trip
invariant_results.evidence: 5 amounts (1e6 to 10_000e6): all round trips lose ~9.75% per direction (fee consistent). At 1e6: spent 1,000,000, received 902,500 (9.75% loss). At 10,000e6: spent 10,000,000,000, received 9,025,000,000. No USDC or WETH profit in any case.

invariant_results.title: Rounding favors protocol (many small swaps)
invariant_results.evidence: 1000 attempted 1-wei swaps: 0 succeeded (all rejected). Protocol correctly rejects sub-minimum swaps. Reserve0 unchanged at 100,000,000,000. Pool value preserved.

invariant_results.title: Token balance solvency
invariant_results.evidence: Multi-LP stress test: 2 LPs, 15 swap rounds in both directions, sequential withdrawal. All _checkSolvency assertions passed (balance >= reserve + feeBalance for both tokens). Combined LP withdrawals correctly include fee income from swap activity.

invariant_results.title: Fee growth monotonicity
invariant_results.evidence: 10 forward swaps: fee growth monotonically increased. Reverse swaps reverted due to InsufficientExpectedReserve (liquidity exhausted), which is correct behavior. Fee growth never decreased during active swaps.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H-R7-CP-01: FullMath.mulDiv with Q64.96 overflow in calculateFixedSwapByRatio
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: FullMath.mulDiv handles 512-bit intermediate products. The packed ratio components (uint128 numerator/denominator) multiplied with uint128 amounts cannot overflow 256 bits before the division. No overflow path exists.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H-R7-CP-02: Q128.128 fee growth overflow via wrapped arithmetic
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Fee growth values use Q128 format in unchecked blocks (intentional wrapping). Fee collection subtracts last-recorded from current, working correctly with wrapping arithmetic per Uniswap V3 design. Not exploitable.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H-R7-CP-05: Position boundary alignment with height precision
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _calculateLiquidityStartAndEndHeights correctly aligns to precision boundaries. Truncation loss (precisionAddLoss) is accounted for. Position start/end heights are always multiples of precision after alignment.
Uses calculateFixedSwapByRatioRoundingDown (mulDiv) for pair value computation. Rounding down means LP receives slightly less than theoretical value, favoring the protocol. No over-payment.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H-R7-CP-13: Fee growth per liquidity scaling asymmetry
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Fee growth increment = mulDiv(feeDistributedToHeight, Q128, liquidity). Proportional distribution to liquidity providers is consistent regardless of direction. No asymmetry found between zeroForOne and !zeroForOne paths.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: INV-S04: Denomination consistency in fee paths
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All fees (LP, protocol, exchange, feeOnTop) are computed and transferred in the same token (tokenIn for input swaps, tokenIn for output swaps). FeeHelper.calculateAmountAfterFeesSwapByInput/Output operate on amountIn consistently. No cross-denomination errors.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: AMMModule strict balance check prevents pool type over-reporting
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Line 2208: balanceInBefore + amountIn != balanceInAfter reverts. Output transfers bounded by _safeDecrementUint128 which reverts on underflow. Multi-pool reserve isolation is correctly maintained.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: feeOnTop unsigned in permit but capped by limitAmount
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: For swapByOutput: feeOnTop added to amountIn BEFORE limitAmount check (line 2171). For swapByInput: feeOnTop deducted from amountIn, reducing output which is checked against limitAmount (line 2156). Both paths capped. Already submitted and rejected (submission #8).

Mathematical proof: boundaryLiquidity = ceil((floor(tcl*num/den)+1)*den/num). Since tcl < (newShare+1)*den/num, it follows that boundaryLiquidity > tcl. Thus boundaryLiquidity - tcl >= 1, and the -1 gives returnableLiquidityDelta >= 0. No underflow possible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Dust first-withdrawer advantage across multiple LPs
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Dust accumulated per swap (lines 1706/1708) is bounded to at most 1 output unit per swap (checked at lines 1699-1702). First LP to withdraw claims all dust (lines 276-286). Maximum advantage: ~1 token unit per swap since pool creation. Economically negligible even after thousands of swaps.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Partial fill +1 input over-charge in swapByOutput
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Line 1680: totalAmountInFilled > amountIn + 1 reverts. At most 1 extra wei of input consumed due to split rounding. Line 1687-1691 recalculates fees for the actual total, so user's excess is covered by proper fee accounting. Dust-level (1 wei max).

summary: Exhaustive deep-dive into all math libraries across fixed pool type, dynamic pool type, single-provider pool type, and core AMM. 29/29 checklist items completed. 26 Forge tests across 4 test files (270 tests total, all pass), 6 fuzz properties with 2048 runs each (no counterexamples), 3 Halmos symbolic properties (1 proven, 2 timeout without counterexample), 3 Medusa property tests (324K calls, 0 failures). 8 hypotheses tested with concrete PoCs. 4 invariants verified (INV-SW02, INV-SW03, INV-S01, INV-E01). 11 vectors ruled out with detailed evidence. No medium+ exploitable findings identified. The codebase is well-hardened at the invariant level with correct rounding directions (symbolically proven for calculateFixedSwapByRatio), proper bounds checking, robust multi-LP accounting, and strict balance verification. The most promising leads (H-R7-CP-12 underflow in _splitAmountsAndFeesByHeight, H-R7-CP-07 precision truncation, H-R7-CP-14 tail height revert) were all ruled out through targeted testing, fuzz testing, symbolic analysis, and mathematical proofs. Flash loan composition, dynamic pool sqrt math, and single-provider pool math were all reviewed via targeted subagents with no exploitable vectors found.
